title: Attempts in Order
description: Three payment attempts on one invoice — declined, timed out, then finally successful — need to read back in the exact order they happened, each with its own honest outcome, not a jumbled or overwritten history.
successCondition: On one invoice, submitting the Pay form three times in sequence with 4000000000000002 (declined), then 4000000000000119 (timed out), then a well-formed ordinary card number (succeeded), renders exactly three list items in oldest-to-newest order: "Attempt 1: declined (card_declined: insufficient funds)", "Attempt 2: timed_out (gateway_timeout: no response from processor)", "Attempt 3: succeeded" — with no failureReason text appended to the successful attempt's line.
hints: The attempt list re-fetches via GET /api/billing/invoices/:id/payments after each pay action — give each request time to resolve before submitting the next.
Only failed/timed-out attempts include a parenthesized reason — a successful line has no trailing "(...)" at all.
